title: Local SEO Citation Builder
description:
About Us

We are a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with law firms. We handle SEO and local search for attorneys across the country. We are a remote team and we value people who do precise, self-directed work. We check results, not hours.



What You’ll Be Doing

You will build local business citation listings for law firm clients across directories and listing sites. Citations must be accurate, complete, and duplicate-free.



 • Research citation opportunities using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) and your own research skills

 • Create a dedicated
 address for each client to use for directory signups

 • Submit and fully complete business profiles on each directory with no skipped fields

 • Check for existing listings before creating anything and never create duplicates

 • Track every citation in a spreadsheet including the profile URL, login
, password, submission date, and status

 • Send a brief written update at the end of each work session



Trial Structure

This is a paid working trial and not a test you do for free. We start with 10 hours split across two law firm clients (5 hours each). If your work is accurate and well tracked, there is regular ongoing work available.



Pay

$7 USD per hour for the trial period. Tell us your experience level when you apply.



What We’re Looking For

 • Meticulous and detail oriented with a habit of rechecking before you submit

 • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to research citation sources

 • Always searches for an existing listing before creating a new one

 • Fills every available field including description, categories, hours, and photos

 • Logs every submission in real time in a spreadsheet

 • Can follow a process and ask smart questions without being hand held

 • Clear written English communication



Tracking Spreadsheet

You will maintain one spreadsheet per client. Every row is one citation. Required columns: Directory Name, Profile URL, Login
, Password, Submission Date, Status (Pending/Live/Claimed/Error), Notes.



How to Apply

Send a message with a brief intro and your citation or SEO experience, the tools and directories you know best, your answer to the question below, and confirmation that you can start immediately. Applications without a complete answer will not be reviewed.

Required Question:

Before you create a new citation listing, what is the first thing you should do and why? Give a specific example of how you would check for an existing listing on a directory like Yelp or Avvo.

This question is intentional. A one line answer is not enough. We want to see how you actually think about this work.

Start your application with the exact phrase: “No Duplicates First.” Applications that do not begin with this phrase will be skipped.

title: REFUND MANAGER AMAZON
description:
We are seeking an experienced Amazon Refund & Claims Manager to take ownership of our reimbursement and dispute recovery processes. Our current Amazon refund loss rate is approximately 2.83%, and the primary goal of this role is to reduce that figure to below 1% by maximising successful claims and recoveries.



The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing Amazon reimbursement claims and disputes, preferably with a company such as GETIDA or a similar reimbursement/audit service provider. You should already understand Amazon’s reimbursement systems, FBA dispute processes, shipment investigations, and how to recover funds efficiently from lost, damaged, misreceived, or incorrectly charged inventory.



Key Responsibilities:



Manage and optimise Amazon reimbursement and refund recovery processes

Identify and reclaim lost revenue through Amazon disputes and investigations

Handle FBA reimbursement cases, shipment discrepancies, damaged/lost inventory claims, and fee disputes

Monitor reimbursement metrics and implement strategies to reduce refund loss rates below 1%

Manage UPS shipment tracking, shipment investigations, and UPS-related disputes/claims

Maintain accurate reporting and documentation for all claims and recoveries

Work closely with management and operations teams to improve processes and reduce recurring issues



Requirements:



Proven experience with Amazon reimbursement management and dispute resolution

Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central, FBA operations, and reimbursement policies

Experience handling UPS shipment disputes and tracking investigations

Ability to work independently while also following management direction and company processes

Strong attention to detail, organisation, and analytical skills

Results-driven mindset with a focus on maximising recoveries and reducing losses

Prior experience at an Amazon reimbursement company or agency is highly preferred



We are looking for someone proactive, experienced, and highly knowledgeable who can take ownership of this area and deliver measurable improvements quickly.

title: Sr. Business Development Lead (Salesforce, SaaS & US Govt RFPs)
description:
About HighCloud Solutions, Inc.



HighCloud Solutions is a Minnesota-based, SBA 8(a) and HUBZone certified consulting firm specializing in Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud), AI/ML, and cloud modernization (AWS, Azure). We hold GSA STARS III contract vehicle, are a certified Salesforce Partner, and serve clients across State, Local, Education (SLED) and Manufacturing sectors. We are also launching FMEAi - our proprietary AI-powered SaaS product that modernizes Failure Mode and Effects Analysis for manufacturing and engineering teams.



We are looking for a long-term partner - not a transactional VA. The right person will start part-time, prove themselves over 60–90 days, and grow into a full-time leadership (Integrator) role with real ownership, and a seat at the leadership table.



THE ROLE

You will be the right hand to the Founder/Visionary, owning day-to-day execution of business development and pre-sales across three lanes:

- Salesforce Consulting Pre-Sales - Lead discovery calls, scope opportunities, build SOWs, deliver demos to mid-market and SLED prospects, and convert qualified leads into signed engagements.

- FMEAi Product Go-to-Market - Run product demos, qualify SaaS leads, support AppExchange listing efforts, and help convert pilots into paying customers across manufacturing accounts.

- US Government Contracting (SLED + Federal) - Identify RFPs/RFQs/RFIs on state procurement portals, and bid-tracking platforms; lead proposal writing and compilation; coordinate teaming partners; manage submission timelines.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Business Development & Pre-Sales

- Generate and qualify outbound pipeline for Salesforce consulting and FMEAi SaaS.

- Conduct discovery calls, scoping sessions, and live product demos via Zoom/Teams.

- Build proposals, SOWs, pricing models, capability statements, and pitch decks.

- Maintain CRM hygiene (HubSpot/Salesforce); track pipeline, forecast accurately, report weekly.

- Support marketing on case studies, datasheets, and AppExchange positioning.



US Government Contracting (SLED & Federal)

- Daily monitoring of SAM.gov, GovWin, state/local procurement portals, and education bid sites.

- Identify and qualify RFP/RFQ/RFI opportunities aligned with HighCloud's NAICS codes, certifications (8(a), HUBZone, STARS III, GSA), and capabilities.

- Lead end-to-end proposal response: outline, win themes, technical narrative drafting, past-performance write-ups, compliance matrix, pricing coordination, and final compilation.

- Coordinate with subcontractors, primes, and teaming partners.

- Maintain a library of reusable boilerplate (capability statements, past performance, resumes, win themes).



Leadership & Growth Path

- Run weekly pipeline reviews with the Founder.

- Hold the team accountable to commitments within our EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) operating cadence.

- Over time, take ownership of execution across sales, marketing, and delivery coordination as the company's Integrator.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years in B2B business development, pre-sales, or sales engineering serving US-based clients.

- Demonstrated experience selling or pre-selling Salesforce consulting services (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Data Cloud).

- Proven experience writing or compiling US government proposals - federal, state, local, or education (SLED). Familiarity with SAM.gov, FAR basics, GSA Schedule, and 8(a)/HUBZone set-asides is highly preferred.

- Excellent written English - capable of producing executive-quality proposals and technical narratives without heavy editing.

- Strong verbal English - comfortable leading live demos and discovery calls with US executives.

- MUST be available US Central Time (CST) hours - minimum 6 hours/day overlap with CST business hours. Non-negotiable.

- Self-directed, organized, able to manage multiple parallel proposals and pipeline activities.

- Proficient with Microsoft 365, Teams, Zoho or Salesforce CRM, Word, PowerPoint.



PREFERRED / BONUS

- Salesforce certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant, AI Associate).

- Prior experience supporting a US small business (8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB).

- Experience with EOS (Rocks, Level 10 Meetings, Scorecards, V/TO, Accountability Chart).

- Experience with FMEA, Six Sigma, or manufacturing quality systems.

- Capture management and proposal writing.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Stable, long-term role with a US-based, growing company.

- Direct working relationship with the Founder.

- Clear path: Part-time ? Full-time ? Integrator within 12 months for the right person.

- Paid Philippine holidays observed.

- Tools, training, and certifications paid for by the company.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

- Updated resume.

- Cover note explaining why this role fits - include your CST availability and monthly salary expectation.

- ONE writing sample: a proposal section, executive summary, or capability narrative you wrote (redacted is fine).

- ONE BD or pre-sales artifact: a deck, demo recording, or pipeline report you built.



Applications without writing and BD samples will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid 2-hour proposal-writing exercise before interview.

We respond to every serious applicant within 7 days. Thank you for considering HighCloud.

title: Amazon PPC Manager (Full-time, Remote)
description:
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Important: We ONLY review applications submitted via the link below. Applications sent through OnlineJobs.ph (or messages) will not be considered.



Please copy/paste this into your browser to apply for the job:



++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++



Belfort Music is looking for an Amazon PPC Manager who operates as a high-level analytical operator within an existing system — someone who can work within our frameworks, optimize accounts at scale, and use AI to work smarter (not just faster). This is a full-time role (40 hours/week) with long-term growth potential, ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys both the analytical and strategic sides of Amazon advertising.



Responsibilities

Strategy & Account Management



-   Following the company frameworks, build PPC strategies that map to each product's lifecycle stage (launch, growth, defend, profit) and the broader business goals, not just generic best practices.



-  Plan, structure, and launch campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display following established account structures and naming conventions.



-  See the bigger picture: when performance shifts, diagnose whether the issue lives in PPC (bids, structure, budget, targeting) or upstream in the listing (CTR, CVR, price, content, reviews) and act on the right lever instead of just adjusting bids.



-  Audit existing accounts and propose data-backed restructures when the current setup is holding performance back.



-  Develop bidding, placement, and keyword strategies driven by CVR, ACoS, TACoS, organic keyword rank, and share-of-voice.



- Track KPIs weekly and produce clear reports that highlight what changed, why it changed, and suggestions on what we should do next.



Optimization & Execution



-   Run bulk file workflows confidently: keyword harvesting, negations, bid adjustments, placement modifiers, and full campaign restructures.



-   Use the Search Query Performance (SQP) report and Search Term Reports to find opportunities and cut waste.



-  Test new Amazon Ads features and report findings back to the team with a clear point of view.



-  Manage budget pacing and adjust placement bids based on real performance data, not assumptions.





AI-Powered Workflow

-  Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to accelerate keyword research, search term analysis, ad copy variants, and SQP/STR review.



-   Build and refine prompts that turn raw bulk files and reports into actionable insights   and document them so the team can reuse them.



-   Combine AI output with your own judgment. You know when to trust the model and when to override it.



-   Continuously identify repetitive parts of your workflow that AI can speed up, automate, or do better  and propose those improvements proactively.



Experience Level: Mid-Level (2+ years)

-   2+ years managing Amazon PPC accounts (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display).



- Hands-on experience with Amazon PPC bulk files.



-   Comfortable using SQP reports and Search Term Reports to drive optimization decisions.



-  Proven ability to think strategically, not just execute checklists.



-   Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and formulas for analysis.



-  Experience with at least one AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and a genuine willingness to expand your AI toolkit.



-  Strong written English communication.



Mindset & Work Ethic

-  Proactive problem solver: You don't wait to be told, you flag issues early and suggest clear solutions.



-   Strong sense of ownership: You take responsibility from start to finish and ensure nothing is left undone.



-   Exceptional organizational skills: You naturally structure work, set priorities, and keep projects on track.



-  Adaptable yet capable: You thrive working within our existing PPC frameworks and SOPs, and you bring genuine analytical depth to improve how those frameworks are applied. 



-   You know when to follow the system and when to surface a smarter approach within it.



-   Customer-centric mindset: You handle communication with clarity and empathy.



-  Collaborative communicator: You keep others in the loop, give helpful updates, and contribute to a healthy team culture.





What Success Looks Like in the First 60–90 Days



Days 1–30 — Learn the system, earn trust



-   You’ve fully absorbed our PPC frameworks, SOPs, and account structures and you’re executing within them accurately.

-   Weekly KPI reports are delivered on time, clearly formatted, and show you understand the “why” behind performance shifts, not just the numbers.

-   You’ve flagged at least one meaningful opportunity or inefficiency in our current setup, and proposed a clear, reasoned fix.



Days 30–60 — Operate with confidence



-   You’re running bulk file workflows independently, keyword harvesting, negations, bid adjustments, with minimal back-and-forth.

-  You’re using SQP and STR data to surface real optimisation insights,  not just reporting the obvious.

-   You’ve introduced at least one AI-assisted workflow improvement and documented it for the team.



Days 60–90 — Drive measurable impact

-   Account performance is trending in the right direction — TACoS, ACoS, and keyword rank are moving in line with product lifecycle targets.

-  You’ve completed at least one meaningful account audit and delivered a structured, data-backed restructure proposal.

- The team trusts your judgment, your communication is proactive, and you require minimal follow-up to stay on top of your responsibilities.



Work Schedule & Compensation

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Flexible, with some overlap during PH business hours (with timetracker)

Long-term role with growth opportunities



To confirm you've read the full listing, answer the screening questions. Take note of the secret word "blueberry".



Benefits

-  Remote role with flexibility during main office hours in the Philippines.

-  Continuous professional development through new strategies and trainings.

-   Be part of a dynamic team focused on growth and learning.

-  Attractive compensation.



Not a good fit if…

This role requires structure, initiative, and clear communication. It's probably not for you if:



- You need constant reminders to stay on top of tasks.

title: Landing Page Media Specialist, Images/Video for Native E-commerce
description:
We run native ad campaigns on US traffic. Every campaign needs a landing page or advertorial that converts. We write the first draft of the copy. You take it from draft to live page.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



For every new landing page or advertorial we send you, you:



1. Read the copy carefully. Catch typos, awkward phrasing, weak hooks, claims that don't track, sections that lose the reader. Flag what's broken. Fix what's small, suggest what's bigger.



2. D
 what visual goes in every media slot. Image or video? What does the visual need to communicate? What's the right emotional tone for this section? You make those calls, we don't tell you "put image X here."



3. Produce the media. Mix existing brand assets, AI generation, stock footage, and editing. Whatever it takes to make each slot stop the scroll and reinforce the copy.



4. Deliver the finished page, copy corrected, media in place, ready to push live.



You're not a designer waiting for a brief. You're the producer who turns a draft into a working ad page.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



— Real copywriting instinct in English. You can tell why a hook is weak. You can tell when a sentence is doing too much work. You know what native ad copy looks like when it works.



— Strong eye for native advertising visuals specifically. Native is not e-commerce product photography. It's editorial-feeling, raw-looking, emotionally loaded. You've seen 1,000 of these pages and you know what stops the scroll vs what gets skipped.



— Fluent in modern AI media tools. Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0, Sedance 2.0, Photoshop or equivalent, plus a video editor of your choice. You move fast between tools.



— You make decisions. We give you the copy and the quality bar, you don't come back with 20 questions about which exact image to use.



— Speed without losing quality. We push high volume. One finished landing page should take you around 1 hour. Across an 8-hour day, you produce 6 to 8 pages without dropping quality. If that sounds impossible, this role isn't for you.



— Bonus: experience with native ad platforms (Taboola, Outbrain, Revcontent) or with the advertorial format specifically.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels & TikTok (Beauty / Aesthetics Niche)
description:
We're launching a new direct-to-consumer beauty / aesthetics service targeting European markets (France, Poland, Spain, Italy). Our growth engine is short-form video on Instagram Reels + TikTok — high-volume, fast-iteration content modeled on accounts that have proven the format in this niche.



We need a video editor who can produce 3–5 polished reels per week in our brand template. You'll work from raw footage + b-roll + brand assets that we provide. Your job is to assemble, pace, and finish the cut: text overlays, motion graphics, captions, sound design, color.



You'll edit ONE master reel per concept, then produce localized variants by swapping text layers and audio (we supply translations + AI-generated voiceovers via ElevenLabs / DeepL / Submagic). The editing template is built once, then re-skinned 4 times.



--- WHAT YOU'LL DO ---



EDITING

- 3–5 reels per week, 15–60 seconds each

- Cut to trending audio + hooks designed to retain viewers in the first 0.5 second

- Motion graphics: text reveals, side-by-side comparisons, zoom-in highlights, arrow callouts, ratio overlays

- Color grade and sound design to a consistent brand look

- Build Premiere templates so locale variants take under 20 minutes each



LOCALIZATION WORKFLOW

- Take 1 master edit and output 4 localized variants (French / Polish / Spanish / Italian)

- Swap text overlays from a translation sheet we supply

- Replace voiceover track with locale-appropriate AI audio we provide

- QC each variant for timing, kerning, and line-breaks per language (text length varies)



ASSET MANAGEMENT

- Organize project files in a clean folder structure (Google Drive)

- Maintain a "concept library" of reusable templates

- Tag and archive raw footage so we can repurpose later



FEEDBACK LOOP

- Light weekly analytics review: which hooks / edits get the most retention

- Iterate the template based on what's working



--- REQUIRED SKILLS (must-have — do not apply without these) ---

- 2+ years editing short-form social video (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)

- Strong CapCut AND Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve / After Effects)

- Motion graphics: text animation, masks, keyframe tracking

- Comfortable working from a brand style guide (fonts, colors, beat timing)

- Fast turnaround: you can deliver a finished reel in under 4 hours from raw footage

- Functional written English — enough to read briefs and reply with questions. Doesn't have to be fluent; we use translation tools both ways.

- Portfolio of edits in the beauty / aesthetics / lifestyle / fashion niche specifically



--- NICE-TO-HAVE ---

- Experience editing beauty-education / aesthetic content

- Familiarity with trending TikTok audio sourcing

- AI tools workflow: ElevenLabs voiceover swaps, automatic captions (Submagic, Captions.ai)

- Speak any of French / Polish / Spanish / Italian (big bonus for QC'ing localized variants — NOT required)

- Some Photoshop / Illustrator for thumbnail and asset prep



--- COMPENSATION ---

$700/month for the first 30-day paid trial (3 master reels/week, deliver on time, hit our quality bar). Bumps to $900–1,100/month after a successful trial. Plus 13th-month and a performance bonus tied to retention metrics (average % watched on the reels you cut).



--- HOURS ---

Approx. 30–40h/week. Mostly async, but available at least 2 hours/day overlap with CET (so ~3 PM – 5 PM Manila time minimum).



--- TO APPLY, SEND ME ---

1. Your reel: a 60-second showreel of your best short-form edits, with timestamps indicating which clips are yours.

2. 3 links to specific reels you edited that performed well (we will check the metrics).

3. Your CapCut OR Premiere project file for ONE of those reels, so we can see your timeline and layer organization (you can scrub client names).

4. The word reels at the very top of your reply so we know you read this whole post.

5. Your salary expectation.



Applications missing any of these will be ignored.

title: Experienced Full-Time Video Editor — Reels, Shorts & YouTube Content
description:
We are a growth and content agency looking for a full-time Video Editor to join our team.



This role is focused specifically on video editing for short-form social media content and long-form YouTube-style content. We are looking for a mid-level to experienced editor who can take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging videos without needing constant step-by-step direction.



This is not a freelance or project-based role. We are looking for someone who can work with us full-time and become part of our internal content production process.



You will be editing content for platforms such as:



Instagram Reels

TikTok

YouTube Shorts


LinkedIn

YouTube



Most of the content will be talking-head, educational, business, marketing, coaching, consulting, and agency-style content.



The ideal person understands how to improve videos through better pacing, stronger hooks, clean captions, better structure, relevant B-roll, jump cuts, zooms, overlays, music, and pattern interrupts.



We currently use CapCut in parts of our workflow, but you do not need to use CapCut exclusively. We are open to editors who use Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or other professional editing tools. The most important requirement is that the final work is high quality, delivered on time, and matches the required style.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Edit short-form videos for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, and LinkedIn.

Edit long-form YouTube videos, usually around 8–12 minutes.

Turn long-form content into short-form clips.

Review raw footage and identify the strongest hooks, key 
nts, and usable clips.

Improve pacing, flow, structure, and viewer retention.

Add captions/subtitles that are easy to read and timed correctly.

Add relevant B-roll, screenshots, overlays, zooms, graphics, music, sound effects, and pattern interrupts.

Remove awkward pauses, mistakes, filler words, dead space, and weak sections.

Follow brand guidelines, editing examples, templates, and references.

Suggest improvements to the editing style, structure, and content flow.

Organise raw footage, project files, exports, and final deliverables clearly.

Work with feedback and complete revisions quickly.

Meet deadlines and maintain consistent monthly output.

Expected Output



Once fully onboarded, the expected monthly output is approximately:



30 short-form videos per month

4–6 long-form YouTube videos per month



Over time, once templates, style guides, and workflows are established, we would like to increase output toward:



40 short-form videos per month

6–8 long-form YouTube videos per month



Quality comes first. We do not want rushed, low-quality edits just to hit volume. However, we do need someone who can work efficiently and handle a consistent monthly production schedule.



REQUIREMENTS

Minimum 3 years of professional video editing experience preferred.

Strong portfolio of short-form social media videos.

Experience editing long-form YouTube-style videos.

Good understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, captions, B-roll, jump cuts, zooms, overlays, and social media editing.

Ability to take raw footage and turn it into polished content with minimal direction.

Strong creative judgment and good visual taste.

Good English comprehension.

Reliable internet connection.

Own laptop or desktop suitable for video editing.

Good file organisation.

Able to follow instructions, examples, and brand guidelines.

Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.

Available full-time.

Able to work with overlap during South African business hours.



PREFERRED

Experience editing business, coaching, consulting, marketing, educational, or agency content.

Experience creating YouTube thumbnails.

Motion graphics skills.

Experience sourcing B-roll, stock footage, screenshots, and visual examples.

Understanding of social media content and YouTube retention.





HOW TO APPLY

Please include the following in your application:



Your video editing portfolio.

2–3 examples of short-form videos you edited.

1–2 examples of long-form YouTube videos you edited.

A short summary of your editing experience.

The editing software you normally use.

Your expected monthly salary.

Your internet speed and computer specs.

Confirmation that you are available full-time.

Confirmation that you can work with overlap during South African business hours.

Applications without relevant video examples will not be considered.

title: Legal-Based Debt Recovery Agent (UK Debt Recovery
description:
About us 



We’re a UK-based credit management and debt recovery firm supporting small businesses. We're firm, fair, and compliant. We focus on outcomes, but we also care about doing the work properly and maintaining professional standards throughout. We already have a well-established team based in the Philippines, and this role will work closely with them.



The role 

We’re hiring a senior debt recovery specialist to manage a high-volume portfolio of UK debt recovery cases with compliance rigour and evidence discipline. This is a compliance-led role with strong case management: you will assess cases for disputes and escalation, gather and document evidence properly, make sound escalation decisions, and communicate clearly with clients and third parties. The balance between case analysis, documentation, and client communication will vary week to week depending on the portfolio.



You will handle a mix of:

• Commercial debts (e.g., Ltd companies)

• Consumer/sole trader matters where the Pre-Action Protocol (PAP) applies

We will train you on the nuances of UK debt recovery law and process; we are hiring for legal literacy and compliance capability.



Hours 

This role is available part-time or full-time (20–40 hours/week). We can offer 40 hours/week immediately for the right candidate. Please confirm your preferred weekly hours and availability in your application.

Salary and bonuses

Salary is up to PHP 50,000/month for the right candidate (depending on experience and performance), plus performance bonuses. This role is paid in PHP and you’ll be joining an established Philippines-based team.

Key responsibilities

• Assess cases for disputes, defences, and evidence gaps; identify issues early and escalate appropriately

• Gather, review, and document evidence (invoices, correspondence, contracts, payment records) to build a clear case narrative

• Draft clear, professional written communications to debtors, clients, and third parties (letters, evidence summaries, escalation memos)

• Identify when cases require legal escalation (statutory demands, court proceedings, etc.) and prepare appropriate paperwork

• Manage compliance-led processes: ensure all actions follow UK law, maintain audit trails, and document decision-making

• Communicate professionally with clients when required (case updates, escalation recommendations, dispute resolution)

• Maintain excellent case notes, timelines, and follow-up discipline so nothing is missed

• Take ownership of progressing cases daily and working to targets (quality and compliance-focused, not “busy work”)



What success looks like



• Cases are assessed thoroughly; disputes and escalation decisions are sound and well-documented

• Written communications are clear, professional, and legally compliant

• Evidence is gathered systematically and presented persuasively

• Notes are accurate, complete, and audit-ready (dates, amounts, evidence summaries, dispute details, escalation decisions, and next actions)

• You remain calm, professional, and objective under pressure; you can make difficult decisions and justify them

• You take pride in doing things properly, not just quickly



Performance and incentives 



We work toward clear targets and reward performance. Bonuses are based on results and quality (e.g., case closures, evidence quality, compliance with standards, and client satisfaction).

Must-have requirements (please don’t apply if you don’t meet these)



• Legal background (law degree, paralegal qualification, or equivalent) OR 3+ years of experience in a legal-services or compliance-led collections environment

• Experience working in a high-volume legal or collections environment (agency or in-house team)

• Demonstrable experience managing disputes, gathering evidence, and making escalation decisions

• Strong written English and the ability to draft clear, professional legal communications

• High attention to detail and strong personal organisation (case notes and documentation are non-negotiable)

• Professional judgement and emotional regulation: objective and composed, able to make difficult decisions

• Comfortable handling a mixed portfolio (commercial and consumer/sole trader matters)

• Comfortable being client-facing when required: able to communicate clearly and professionally with business owners/clients and third parties

• Understanding of legal/compliance-led debt recovery processes: able to work within due diligence frameworks and understand escalation pathways

Work setup requirements (must-have)

• Reliable laptop/desktop suitable for daily case management work

• Stable, high-speed internet connection and a quiet, private workspace for calls and written work

• Headset with clear audio (noise-cancelling preferred)

• Working webcam and microphone (required for interview, training, and occasional check-ins)

• Backup internet option (mobile data is fine) for continuity

• You must be able to maintain consistent connectivity during agreed working hours

• We provide the calling/VOIP system for debtor calls



Additional experience (beneficial, but not required) If you don’t have these, you can still be a strong fit — please apply if you meet the must-haves.



• UK debt recovery exposure (e.g., familiarity with LBA/PAP, UK court/claims process, or UK compliance expectations)



Fit and standards



This is not a customer service role. We're seeking a legal professional who can accurately assess cases, make sound decisions, and document everything thoroughly. If you prefer a highly scripted environment, avoid written work, or struggle with compliance-driven processes, this role will not be a good fit.

Screening



To be considered, you must complete our short TestGorilla assessment. We will only review candidates who complete the assessment.

title: ACCOUNTANT (CPA - CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE)
description:
Accountant (Construction Industry)



We're looking for a Certified Public Accountant with construction industry experience to support a financial services and advisory business that works with small contractors across the United States. You will clean up messy books, build operational financial infrastructure for clients, and serve as the senior accounting resource as the practice scales.



This is a client-facing role supporting small construction businesses typically under $5 million in annual revenue. You need to understand how construction accounting actually works, including job costing, WIP schedules, percentage-of-completion, retainage, and AIA billing. Familiarity with U.S. tax law is a strong advantage.



Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

- Work with a growing book of small construction clients and build long-term relationships

- Opportunity to grow into a senior lead role overseeing bookkeepers as the practice scales



 What You'll Work On



Client Bookkeeping and Cleanup



- Clean up and reconcile books for small contractor clients with messy or disorganized financials

- Identify errors, missing transactions, and categorization issues and resolve them systematically

- Bring client books up to date and maintain them on an ongoing basis



Construction-Specific Accounting



- Manage job costing and project-level profitability tracking

- Maintain work-in-progress schedules and percentage-of-completion reporting

- Handle retainage tracking and AIA billing documentation

- Ensure financials reflect the operational reality of each construction project



Financial Infrastructure Building



- Set up and optimize QuickBooks Online for each client

- Build reporting structures, chart of accounts, and workflows that give clients clear visibility into their finances

- Create systems that are scalable and easy for clients to maintain



Tax and Compliance Support



- Apply working knowledge of U.S. tax law to support client tax readiness

- Coordinate with CPAs or tax preparers on filings where needed

- Ensure books are clean and organized ahead of tax season



What You Bring



- Active CPA license or CPA-equivalent accounting credential

- Hands-on experience with construction accounting including job costing, WIP, retainage, and AIA billing

- Strong QuickBooks Online proficiency, QBO certification preferred

- Working knowledge of U.S. tax law and its application to small business clients

- Experience cleaning up disorganized books and building financial systems from scratch

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills for client-facing work

- Self-directed and organized with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously



Nice to Have



- Experience working with small contractors or subcontractors under $5M in revenue

- QBO ProAdvisor certification

- Background in a bookkeeping, accounting, or advisory firm serving construction clients

- Familiarity with construction-specific software such as Buildertrend, Procore, or Foundation



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your updated resume

2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your construction accounting experience, and walking through how you have cleaned up a client's books or built financial infrastructure from scratch



**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you know construction accounting inside and out, can bring order to messy books, and want to build a long-term client base inside a growing advisory practice, this role gives you the ownership and the scope to do your best work.

description:

Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.

If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

description:
We're trying to solve the world's biggest problem: People don't #Believe in themselves enough. For over 22 years, Evan Carmichael has been dedicated to this mission. The right video at the right time can completely change someone's life and we want to touch as many lives as possible. • Cold Calling &
ing: Execute high-volume outbound campaigns (cold calls,
s, and LinkedIn outreach) to introduce Dorset Tech's services.

s, and follow-ups in our CRM system.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Job Brief  



We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Credit Analyst to support our lenders in managing the end-to-end mortgage application process. This role requires a professional with a minimum of 3 to 4 years of specific Australian mortgage and lending experience; as such, we are looking for a candidate who can hit the ground running without the need for foundational training. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of a loan, from lead conversion and data entry to credit assessment and post-settlement enquiries. While you will receive initial support, you are expected to take full ownership of your workflow, ensuring all applications meet rigorous credit policies and legislative standards. 



Responsibilities 

Salesforce & LoanApp Management: Managing accurate data entry within Salesforce and overseeing the LoanApp platform to ensure seamless application flows. 

Lead Conversion: Creating leads and converting them into opportunities within the CRM system. 

Application Submission: Submitting completed loan applications to the funder and issuing credit guides where applicable. 

Valuation Management: Ordering and managing valuation reports to ensure property security meets lending criteria. 

Reporting & Title Searches: Generating comprehensive credit reports and completing necessary title searches. 

Progress Draw Management: Overseeing the management of progress draws for construction or staged funding. 

KYC Compliance: Completing Know Your Customer (KYC) verifications using tools such as IDyou or IDkit. 

Documentation & Signatures: Completing all required application forms and coordinating the sending of documents for digital signatures. 

Financial Calculations: Completing funding tables and servicing calculators to determine borrower capacity. 

Credit Proposal Drafting: Drafting detailed credit proposals for formal credit assessment. 

Credit Assessment: Assessing applications prior to submission to the senior credit analyst for final review. 

Policy Compliance: Reviewing credit limits in line with specific internal policies and procedures.

Approval Recommendations: Recommending applications for approval or decline based on risk analysis. 

Underwriter Liaison: Dealing with underwriter Mortgage Information Requests (MIR) and resolving technical queries. 

Outcome Notification: Issuing formal approval or decline letters to relevant parties. 

Settlement Support: Assisting with a wide range of pre-settlement and post-settlement enquiries. 



Requirements 

3–4 years of direct experience in Australian mortgage lending (lender-side experience is essential; broker-side only will not be considered). 

Proven ability to handle the end-to-end loan process with minimal supervision. 

Deep understanding of Australian credit policies and lending benchmarks. 

Advanced analytical, mathematical, and comprehension skills. 

Ability to manage competing deadlines effectively in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. 

Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies in complex financial data. 

Strong communication skills for interacting with underwriters and internal stakeholders. 



Software Proficiency 

Salesforce (nice to have) 

LoanApp 

IDyou / IDkit 

Credit Reporting Tools (Equifax / Illion) 

Servicing Calculators 

Microsoft Office Suite 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or other business-related fields. 

Additional certifications in Australian Mortgage Broking or Financial Services are highly desirable. 



Personal Attributes 

Critical thinking – Ability to evaluate applications objectively and identify potential risks. 

Consistent and methodical – A disciplined approach to following processes and procedures. 

Persistence – Dedication to seeing complex applications through to completion and resolving MIRs. 

Team orientated – A collaborative mindset focused on supporting lenders and the wider credit team. 

Love of learning – A desire to stay updated on evolving Australian lending regulations and policies. 



Time Zone: Australian Business Hours 



Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Artificial Intelligence Doom Niche)
description:
Hiring: A+ Long-Form Editors for Fast-Growing AI Channel (Daily Uploads)



We run a YouTube channel in the AI niche currently doing 100K+ views per day and scaling to daily uploads, with a second channel in the same niche launching. We need editors who can match a very specific style, not generic long-form editing.



The Channel's Emotional Tone (Most Important):



This channel evokes fear and doom around AI: AI taking jobs, AI taking over, the inevitability of massive change coming. Every visual choice has to reinforce that mood. Dark, charged, unsettling - never neutral, never corporate, never bright stock-footage. 



If you don't intuitively understand why dark imagery + real-world layoff headlines + Terminator/I Robot-style footage outperforms generic B-roll of people typing at laptops, this role isn't for you.



This is our channel, if you can replicate this style, please apply: 





What You'll Do:



Edit long-form videos (16-20 minutes) from raw footage including a HeyGen avatar voiceover and commentary clips. The first 30 seconds is the most critical and edit-heavy part of every video - high tension, fast pacing, dark imagery, real headlines. The rest of the video is much lighter: interviews and commentary playing through with light B-roll and captions .



Your job is to:



Hide jump cuts in the avatar voiceover with relevant B-roll

Source dark, charged B-roll (humanoid robots, dystopian imagery, AI documentaries, downloaded YouTube clips, HD images  NOT Storyblocks corporate stock)

- Layer in real-world headlines (Klarna layoffs, Coinbase layoffs, AI job displacement stories) screenshotted and highlighted

- Pace the intro for maximum tension and hook retention

Clean audio, tight transitions with intentional music cues



Required:



- High-level English

- Fast communication (we run multiple channels and move quickly)

- Proven long-form YouTube editing experience

- Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut

- Ability to independently source B-roll that matches the emotional tone without being told every time

- Available for consistent daily/near-daily work



Pay:

$40 USD per video delivered. We can provide up to 1 video per day ($1,200/month). Minimum expectation is 3 videos per week ($480/month). Performance bonuses available. Turnaround: 24-48 hours per video.



Style References - Watch These First:



Before you apply, watch the intros of these three videos to understand what we're aiming for:











If you can't replicate this intensity, pacing, and tone - don't apply.



Trial Edit (Required)



Edit the first 60 seconds of this raw footage in the style above:





Use music from this channel for the intro music, transitioned into background music for the commentary: 
 



Applications without a completed trial will be ignored. 



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word: banana (confirms you read the post)

2. Submit your trial edit (Google Drive link, unlisted YouTube link, or similar)

3. In 2-3 sentences, tell us why you think AI doom content gets clicks - we want to know you understand the psychology, not just the software



Why This Role

We run multiple fast-growing channels and are building a long-term A-player team. If you're fast, detail-oriented, want to learn how some of the fastest-growing YouTube channels in the world operate behind the scenes, and want consistent high-volume work with room to grow into senior roles as we scale - this is the role.

description:

Remote | 20 hours per week | PHP 30,000/month



You're good at what you do — but your skills deserve a role built around them.



You've spent time building experience in construction administration. You know how to manage project files, track costs, coordinate with trades, and keep compliance documentation airtight. But you're in a role that doesn't fully use what you know — or worse, you're stuck doing generic admin that has nothing to do with the industry you've invested in.

About the Company

Go Ignite is partnering with an established Australian residential construction company. With over 20 years of industry experience, they specialise in custom renovations and rebuilds — delivering homes that reflect the lifestyle and needs of their clients, from concept through to completion.



They are a close-knit, owner-operated business with a strong focus on quality craftsmanship, clear communication, and organised project delivery. They're growing, and they need a highly capable administration professional to help keep multiple projects running smoothly behind the scenes.



About the Role

This is a remote, specialist construction administration role working directly with the business owners. You will be embedded in the day-to-day operations of an active residential building company — managing the systems, documentation, and reporting that keep projects on track and on budget.



The primary platform is Wunderbuild, and experience using it is essential. You will also work across Tom's Planner for scheduling, and Google Sheets or Excel for cost tracking and comparison work.



This is a 20-hour per week engagement with genuine potential to grow as the business scales.



What You'll Be Doing:



Project & Construction Administration

-Invoice reconciliation and project cost tracking across active builds

-Carpentry hours reconciliation and timesheet management

-Maintaining and updating project schedules using Tom's Planner

-Tracking project margins and supporting financial reporting

-Uploading and managing all project documentation within Wunderbuild

-Supporting procurement processes and coordinating supplier pricing requests

-Assisting with pricing take-offs and quote request coordination

Safety & Compliance Administration

Team & Operational Support

What You'll Bring:

Proven experience in Wunderbuild — this is non-negotiable

Background in residential construction administration or project coordination

Strong proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets

High attention to detail and a structured, organised approach to work

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities without dropping the ball

Confident working independently in a remote setup with minimal supervision



Why This Opportunity Is Different:

This is not a generic VA role dressed up as construction admin. The work is specific, the systems are industry-standard, and the person who fills this role will be a genuine operational contributor — not a task executor.



You'll work directly with owners who are engaged, communicative, and serious about getting the right person. There are flexible working arrangements to suit your schedule, and for the right candidate, this role has real room to grow in scope and hours over time.



If you have the niche background this requires, this is a rare chance to do meaningful, skilled work for a reputable Australian builder — from wherever you are in the Philippines.



Compensation & Benefits

PHP 30,000 per month

20 hours per week engagement

Fully remote, flexible working arrangements

Direct working relationship with business owners

Immediate start available

Growth potential as the business expands

Send your CV and a brief cover note.

title: Webflow Developer (Short-Term Project – Scroll Animation & Brand Reveal)
description:
Project Type: Temporary / Project-based



Platform: Webflow



Template in Use: Rustico Webflow Template (
)



----------



Overview



We’re looking for a skilled Webflow developer to build a high-impact, scroll-based brand reveal section on our website.



This section will introduce our new branding and logomark through a cascading animation as users scroll down the page. The experience should feel premium, smooth, and intentional.



If this project is executed well, there will likely be additional Webflow work in the future.



---



What We Need Built



We need cascading elements as you scroll down the webpage that introduces our new branding and logomark as it fade in (or stack in, from the top to bottom) piece by piece with a small bit of text explaining the element. 



When the next piece comes, the previous text will fade and the new one will fade in. Eventually, once the full logomark is assembled, it should move to the left (or right) with a fade in of more text which will be a little "about us" on the right hand side.



More technical detail:



1. Cascading Logomark Assembly

    - Individual elements of our logomark fade or stack in sequentially (top to bottom or layered build).

    - Each element appears as the user scrolls.



2. Dynamic Text Transitions

    - As each new logomark element appears:

        - The previous explanatory text fades out.

        - New corresponding text fades in.

    - Smooth transitions with no layout shift.



3. Final Composition State

    - Once the full logomark is assembled:

        - It shifts left (or right).

        - A larger “About Us” text block fades in on the opposite side.



4. Fully Editable Setup

    - All text, animation timing (where possible), and structure must be editable inside Webflow.

    - Clean class naming and structured layout.



5. Knowledge Transfer

    - Walk us through how it’s built.

    - Show us how to edit and maintain it.

    - Ideally provide a short Loom walkthrough.



---



Technical Expectations



- Strong experience with:

    - Webflow Interactions (IX2)

    - Scroll-based animations

    - Clean layout structuring

- Ability to extend beyond default interactions if needed (custom code acceptable if justified)

- Maintain responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile

- Performance-conscious implementation (no laggy animation chains)



---



Deliverables



- Fully implemented section inside our existing Rustico template

- Responsive across breakpoints

- Editable CMS-friendly structure (if applicable)

- Handover walkthrough



---



To Apply



Please include:

- 2–3 examples of scroll-based Webflow animations you’ve built

- Confirmation that you can make this fully editable

- Estimated timeline

- Fixed project price



---



If this project goes well, we anticipate ongoing collaboration for future Webflow enhancements.

title: Senior Financial Controller (Xero) — Rebuild & Own the Finance Function of a Fast-Scaling E-commerce Brand
description:
We're an Australian premium e-commerce retailer — pool tables, arcade machines, pinball, kegerators, saunas and more. We do $10M in revenue and we're scaling to $40M over the next two years. We run our own warehousing, national delivery and an installation team. We're ambitious, we move fast, and we are dead serious about fixing our finance function properly this time.



We're looking for a Senior Financial Controller to take full ownership of our books, rebuild our Xero from the ground up, and turn it into the system the business actually steers by. This is a long-term, full-time, ongoing role. It is not a project, not a tidy-up, and not a part-time advisory seat.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING — WE'RE BEING COMPLETELY STRAIGHT WITH YOU



Our books are not in good shape, and we're not going to pretend otherwise. Xero is disconnected from our inventory system. Our cost of goods is inflated and nobody can fully explain why. Our chart of accounts can't show us profit by product category or by department. We've had two bookkeepers and two senior finance people through this business and the books are no better than a year ago. We have strong data sitting in our other systems — Shopify, Unleashed, Polar Analytics — but nothing ties together in Xero, and Xero is not currently a source of truth.



We are telling you this upfront because we want someone who reads that and gets interested, not nervous. If untangling a genuine mess and building order out of it is the work you're best at and enjoy most, keep reading. If you want a clean set of books to gently maintain, this is the wrong role and we'll both know it quickly.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS

You will own the finance function. Not assist it — own it. In your first months the job is heavy reconstruction: you will pull apart what's wrong, rebuild the Xero chart of accounts properly, and rebuild trust in every number. Once it's clean, you run it — month-end, management accounts, cash flow, reporting — and you keep it immaculate. You'll work directly with the CEO and closely with our operations team, and you'll be the person who can answer, with confidence and evidence, “are we actually making money, and where?”



WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER

The headline outcomes we are hiring you to produce:

- Xero rebuilt as the single source of truth — a clean, correctly structured chart of accounts the leadership team trusts without second-guessing.

- Profit visibility by product category — pool tables, arcade, pinball, kegerators, dartboards, LED and furniture — so we finally know which categories make money and which don't. This is a build and depends on cost inputs being cleaned up over time; you'll be central to getting there.

- Departmental P&L — cost-centre reporting so marketing, sales, operations and admin can each see and own their numbers.

- Reliable month-end — a full close and management accounts the business can make real decisions on, every month, on time.

- A 13-week rolling cash flow forecast — we have seasonal revenue and financing facilities; we need to see cash coming before it becomes a problem.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN DAY TO DAY

- Rebuilding and maintaining the Xero chart of accounts and tracking-code structure.

- Untangling cost of goods — core stock vs drop-ship, freight-in vs freight-out, installation costs, merchant fees, and the inventory adjustment journals currently muddying the picture.

- Owning the reconciliation of data flowing from Shopify and our inventory system (Unleashed) into Xero, with no unexplained variances. Our operations team owns the inventory system itself — you are the person who makes sure it reconciles cleanly into the books.

- The full month-end close and management accounts.

- The 13-week cash flow view and tracking of our financing facilities.

- Bank reconciliation, accounts payable, supplier invoice processing and payment run preparation.

- Feeding clean, reliable data to our external Australian tax accountant, who handles tax, GST and BAS.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- This is a senior role and we need a senior person. Specifically:

- 6+ years in accounting or finance, with real depth in e-commerce, retail or inventory-heavy businesses.

- Genuine Xero mastery — you have personally restructured a chart of accounts and built a tracking-code framework, not just worked inside one someone else set up. Xero certification expected or close to it.

- A demonstrable track record of taking messy, untrusted books and making them clean and reliable — this is the single most important thing we're hiring for.

- Strong command of inventory and cost-of-goods accounting — you understand how landed cost, stock and COGS move through the books.

- Confident building cost-centre and category-level reporting from scratch.

- Hands-on with Shopify and an inventory/ERP system (Unleashed or similar).

- Self-directed and accountable — you own outcomes, surface problems early, and don't need chasing.

- Excellent written and spoken English, and genuinely confident leading a conversation on a weekly video call with the CEO.

- A reliable internet connection, a quiet space for video calls, and solid working overlap with Australian Eastern time (AEST).



WHAT'S IN IT FOR THE RIGHT PERSON

- Full ownership of a finance function from day one — this is your domain to build.

- A genuine path to a senior finance leadership seat as we scale toward $40M; we want this person to grow with us.

- A long-term, stable, full-time role with a business that's serious about getting this right and will back you to do it.

- A proper handover and structured onboarding — you will not be dropped in cold.

- Direct line to the CEO; your work will visibly drive how the business makes decisions.

- Paid local Philippine public holidays and a genuine commitment to a long-term working relationship.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications must be submitted through our application form. Applications that come only as a message here, without the form completed, will not be reviewed.



Apply here: 



We're interviewing immediately and moving quickly for the right person.

title: Bookkeeper / Accountant  —  Full Time (Permanent)
description:
# Remote Bookkeeper — Full-Time



We're hiring a full-time remote bookkeeper to run project invoicing, payments, reconciliation in QuickBooks Online. Accuracy and consistency are the entire job.



---



## The kind of bookkeeping



We're a distribution business — project-based B2B bookkeeping. Customer payments come in two stages — typically 50?posit at order, balance before delivery. Supplier payments mirror that structure where required (deposit to start production, balance once production is complete). Some suppliers are on net 30 terms; every bill is PO-driven. The business operates between Canada and the US.



If your background is SaaS, retail, or subscription bookkeeping, this is a different rhythm. Experience in distribution, construction, manufacturing, or project-based services is a strong asset.



---



## Compensation & Hours



- **Full-time, 40 hours/week**

- Hourly rate: **$5–10/hr** depending on experience

- Permanent role



---



## What you'll do



**Project invoicing (QBO)**

When a customer pays a deposit or design fee, trigger the project sequence: create the Project under the customer using the next sequential project code, move the Estimate into the Project, convert it to an Invoice, and record the payment. Apply every payment to the correct invoice and project — especially for customers running multiple active projects at the same time, where a misapplied payment silently corrupts both projects' books.



**Accounts Payable**

- Track every outstanding payable — what's owed, to whom, when it's due, and what stage of payment it's in

- Match every supplier bill to its PO before entering in QBO

- Create payment orders in RBC PayEdge — approved before they go out

- Time supplier final payments correctly: the customer's final payment must clear before the supplier's balance is paid



**Contractors**

- Reconcile contractor invoices against Time Doctor hours before payment

- Pay contractors on schedule



**Accounts Receivable**

- Track every outstanding invoice in real time — nothing slips through the cracks

- Actively follow up with customers when payments come due; escalate aging accounts before they become problems

- Collect customer payments and apply every receipt to the correct invoice and project

- Maintain a live AR aging view that anyone on the team can check at any 
nt



**Communication**

- Monitor finance-related
s from customers, suppliers, and the internal team

- CC the assigned tea
mber on every external
; always reply-all on threads

- Organize all
 threads into a clear folder structure — at any 
nt, anyone should be able to open the inbox and immediately see the status of every conversation (open, awaiting reply, paid, closed, etc.)

- Coordinate with the team in Slack — no silent backlogs



**Workflow (Asana)**

- Work inside our project workflow. Each role triggers the next — when a task is complete, the right person is notified automatically

- Track every task due today, this week, and overdue across all projects — nothing dropped, nothing forgotten

- Keep your tasks current; flag blockers immediately



---



## Long-term projects



Beyond day-to-day work, this role will also drive larger improvement initiatives, including:



- **Migrating all financial data from the customer level to the project level in QBO** — restructuring historical records so every invoice, bill, payment, and expense is tied to its specific project, not just the parent customer. This unlocks accurate per-project profitability and clean reporting.



More long-term projects will be added over time as the business scales.



---



## Tools



QuickBooks Online, RBC PayEdge, Time Doctor, Slack, Asana, Excel / Google Sheets.



---



## What "good" looks like



- Zero unapplied payments. Zero duplicate customer records. Zero sloppy project coding.

- Zero misapplied payments on multi-project accounts — every payment lands on the right invoice under the right project, every time.

- Every supplier bill matched to a PO before payment.

- Every supplier final balance paid only after the customer's payment has cleared.

- Audit trail clean enough that anyone can open a project and understand what happened.

- Asana tasks moved as work progresses — never silent for days.



---



## Requirements



- Proven QuickBooks Online experience (Projects, Estimates, Invoices, Bills, POs)

- Strong accounts payable discipline (PO matching, bill creation, payment recording)

- Strong written English and clear communication

- High attention to detail — you catch mismatched totals and missed steps before anyone else does

- Comfortable working inside documented SOPs and Asana-driven workflows — you follow the process and flag deviations rather than freelancing

- Strong preference for experience with deposit-based project billing, supplier net terms, and cross-border (Canada/US) operations

- Ecommerce bookkeeping experience is an asset, not a requirement



---



## Schedule



- Remote

- Full-time, Monday to Friday

- 4 hours of daily overlap required: 9am–1pm Eastern Time

- Remaining hours flexible



---



## To apply



Fill out the application form: 



We'll get back to those who qualify for an interview with a Calendly invite.

Our current work includes fire system pipework, drainage, pump rooms, carriageway installations, and large-scale M&E packages on data centre, pharmaceutical, and infrastructure projects.

s the same business day, and keeping every thread moving.

s the same day. If you cannot answer, you let people know when you will.

description:

Go Ignite is hiring a skilled Estimator for a fully remote, full-time role based in the Philippines.



About the opportunity

A legitimate AU construction career — without leaving home



You've built your estimating skills around Australian construction standards, learned the NCC, and gotten comfortable working with AU-based teams across time zones. But finding a remote role that actually matches that experience — with stable hours, a professional setup, and work that challenges you — hasn't been easy.



This is that role:

You'll be embedded directly into an Australian building and property services business, managing real tender pipelines and cost estimates for residential and commercial projects — working Philippine hours, from your home office, with weekends to yourself.



About the company:

An Australian building and property services business built on quality and efficiency



We are a growing Australian construction and trades company operating across residential and commercial sectors. We run a modern, systems-driven operation using Buildertrend to manage project workflows end-to-end — from initial quote through to delivery.



We’re expanding our remote team and are looking for a sharp, self-directed estimator who takes ownership of their numbers.



The role: Estimator:

You will be the primary estimating resource for the business — responsible for preparing accurate, competitive cost estimates and tender submissions for Australian construction projects.



Working closely with the project management and operations team, you will ensure every bid is grounded in solid data, clear scope, and fully compliant with Australian building standards.



What you'll be doing:

Estimating and cost planning

-Prepare detailed and accurate cost estimates for residential and commercial construction projects from supplied plans and specifications

-Conduct quantity take-offs from architectural and engineering drawings to determine material and labour requirements

-Analyse project scope documents, specifications, and site conditions to produce comprehensive and competitive quotes

-Develop and maintain a cost database of materials, labour rates, and subcontractor pricing to support efficient estimation

-Review and update estimates as project scope or design changes occur throughout the pre-construction phase



Tendering and bid management

-Prepare and submit well-structured tender documents, pricing schedules, and supporting documentation within required deadlines

-Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to obtain competitive quotations and incorporate them into overall bid pricing

-Assess and evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotes for accuracy, scope coverage, and value for money

-Manage multiple tender submissions concurrently, maintaining a tender register and tracking outcomes to improve win rates over time

-Buildertrend and project system management

-Utilise Buildertrend to manage and track estimate data, project budgets, and pre-construction documentation

-Upload and maintain project files, drawings, and specifications within Buildertrend for team-wide accessibility

-Generate and export cost reports and estimate summaries from Buildertrend for review by project managers and leadership

-Assist in configuring and updating Buildertrend templates to reflect current pricing and scope structures

-Ensure all estimate-related data within Buildertrend is accurate, current, and properly categorised at all times



Australian building code and compliance awareness

-Apply knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards when assessing project scope and specifications

-Identify compliance requirements related to structural, safety, and regulatory standards when reviewing plans

-Flag potential cost impacts arising from code compliance obligations and communicate these clearly to the project team

-Stay current with updates to Australian building codes, industry standards, and best practice requirements



Coordination and stakeholder communication

-Collaborate closely with the project management and operations team to clarify scope and resolve estimating queries in a timely manner

-Communicate estimate assumptions, inclusions, and exclusions clearly in writing to support informed decision-making by the client team

-Participate in regular virtual meetings with the leadership team to review tender pipelines and project pricing strategies

-Support handover of awarded projects to the project delivery team by documenting estimate assumptions and budget allocations



What you'll bring:

-Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in construction estimating, with exposure to Australian residential or commercial projects

-Demonstrated proficiency in Buildertrend for estimate management, project documentation, and cost reporting

-Working knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian construction standards

-Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and tender documents

-Excellent written and verbal English communication skills suited to a remote, cross-timezone collaboration environment

-Experience with quantity surveying or cost planning methodologies is an advantage

-Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated professional home office setup



Why this opportunity is different:

Stable hours. Consistent work. A team that values precision.



This isn't project-based or seasonal work. You're joining a full-time operation with a structured day shift schedule and weekends off — meaning your work life is predictable and your personal time is protected.



The business is operationally mature and systems-driven. You'll work with proper tooling, clear processes, and a team that respects the craft of good estimating.



If you've been looking for a long-term remote role where your technical skills are taken seriously, this is it.



Compensation and benefits

-Full-time engagement — 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

-Day shift schedule with weekends off

-Monthly salary of PHP 45,000 to PHP 55,000, commensurate with experience + Performance bonus

-Paid time off + Prepaid HMO 



How to apply:

Ready to bring your AU construction knowledge into a role that values it?



Send your CV to GO Recruit along with a brief response to the screening question below. We review every application personally — but applications submitted without a response to the screening question will not be progressed.

Screening question: 

1. Describe your experience using Buildertrend in a construction estimating context — specifically, how you have used it to manage estimate data, generate cost reports, or support tender submissions. 

2. If you have not used Buildertrend, tell us which estimating platform you have used and how your experience would transfer.

title: Customer Onboarding & Technical Support Specialist (Mac & Windows)
description:
About Caddy



Caddy is an AI productivity tool that customers install on their own Mac or Windows machines. Every customer goes through a guided install call before they can use the product. Right now I run those calls personally. I am hiring this role to take that over and to handle support after the install.



What you will do



1. Run customer install calls.

   Most calls are 60 to 90 minutes on Zoom or Google Meet with screenshare. You walk the customer through commands in Terminal (Mac) or PowerShell (Windows). You explain what each step does in plain language so non-technical customers feel comfortable. You troubleshoot when something does not go to plan (PATH issues, Gatekeeper prompts on Mac, permission popups, plugin install errors, etc).



2. Send the welcome
 and run the GitHub access steps live on the call.

   I will give you a runbook that lists every step in order.



3. Handle the customer support inbox after install.

   You triage incoming
, answer the easy questions yourself, draft replies for me to review on the harder ones, and flag anything that looks urgent.



4. Keep our internal runbook accurate.

   When you find a step that confused a customer or a fix that worked, you update the runbook so the next install goes smoother.



Who you are



- Comfortable in the command line on both Mac (Terminal, Homebrew) AND Windows (PowerShell, Scoop). This is non-negotiable since our customers are split across both.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on live calls with US-based business owners.

- Patient and calm with non-technical people. You can explain what a "package manager" is to someone who has never opened Terminal before.

- Strong troubleshooting instincts. When something breaks mid-install, you stay composed and work it through.

- Reliable on a US-overlap schedule. Most install calls will be booked during US business hours (Pacific or Central).



Nice to have



- Prior experience with Claude Code, Cursor, or any AI developer tool.

- Familiarity with GitHub (you will be adding customers as collaborators to private repos).

- Prior SaaS customer support experience.



What we offer



- Stable full-time role with a single owner (me) as your only point of contact.

- Clear runbooks for every step you will do.

- 13th month pay.

- Paid Philippine holidays.

- Performance bonuses as the customer base grows.



How to apply



In your application, please answer these three questions in your own words:

2. What is the most recent piece of technology, software, or app you taught yourself how to use? How did you learn it (videos, articles, trial and error, asking someone)?

Applications without answers to these four questions will not be reviewed.
